messages:
Anne (eng-platform): Heads-up — we're planning to cut internal-api-kit v2 this week. It renames the routing header and changes handshake semantics. This will break current SDKs unless we coordinate a compatibility path. Can we sketch a rollout checklist here?
Sam (platform): Ack. What's the exact header rename?
Anne (eng-platform): Old: `x-rw-route` (string route tag + affinity). New: `x-rd-route-policy` (structured, JSON-ish string). Also handshake now returns `x-rd-route-version` in responses.
Mira (devex): Console implications: traces + per-route cost dashboards will need a translation layer for historic data. We should add a deprecation banner in Console > Admin for SDK owners.
John (qa): Go client will likely break because of net/http canonicalization (lowercase headers). We saw this before — tests fail if header casing changes. Need a unit+e2e matrix: Py/TS/Go against old and new formats.
Leo (eng): I propose a 30-day shim in internal-api-kit that accepts both headers and emits the new header in outgoing requests. That buys SDK teams time.
Anne (eng-platform): Good. Add a feature flag `internal_api_compat_v2` so we can flip off the shim once 90% of traffic is on new clients.
Mira (devex): Telemetry: emit an event `sdk.route_header_migration` with props { sdk_name, sdk_version, opted_in }. That will let Console show a migration progress tile.
Sam (platform): Rollout plan idea: canary 5%/20%/60%/100% over 72 hours, with health checks on token-level latency and route-cost delta. If any route SLO regresses >3% for 15m, pause.
John (qa): QA checklist notes:
- matrix tests: Py 3.10/3.11, Node 18/20, Go 1.20/1.21
- integration harness hitting canary routing service
- rate-limiter and batching checks (header affects route hashing)

Leo (eng): Small snippet for the shim we can drop into API gateway:
```
// pseudo-js
function normalizeRouteHeaders(req) {
  if (req.headers['x-rw-route']) req.headers['x-rd-route-policy'] = convert(req.headers['x-rw-route'])
  // preserve original for logging
}
```

Mira (devex): SDK side: we should ship optional opt-in helpers first (e.g., setRoutePolicy({ compat: true })) that use the shim by default. That avoids immediate breakage and signals intent.
Sam (platform): Also update the telemetry contract doc and add sampling rules so we don't flood events. 1% sampling for opt-in metrics, 100% for migration errors.
Anne (eng-platform): PR checklist for internal-api-kit and SDKs:
- docs: migration guide + code samples for Py/TS/Go
- changelogs with clear BREAKING CHANGE callout
- compatibility tests in CI matrix (run old server vs new SDK, and new server vs old SDK)
- console tile + deprecation banner implemented behind a flag
- create a support runbook for customer escalations

John (qa): One gotcha: route hashing uses header tokenization. If new format contains JSON, ensure the hashing function normalizes fields order. Add fuzz tests.
Leo (eng): I'll open a tiny RFC PR with the hashing normalization algorithm and a short reference implementation in Go + TS.
Mira (devex): UX for rollout: in Console Admin -> SDK Migrations show: percent migrated, top tenants still on old header, and a quick link to add fallback in SDK. + email to SDK owners list when 10% remains.
Sam (platform): Can we also add a `migration-mode` query param to the internal handshake endpoint to force new behavior for testing? E.g., `?migration=force-v2`
Anne (eng-platform): Yes — add it gated by an internal feature flag only. Good for e2e.
Leo (eng): Timeline proposal: today: RFC + shim PR; tomorrow: SDK opt-in helpers + docs; Wed: run canary; Thur-Fri: monitor and expand.
Mira (devex): I'll draft the Console tile mock and the migration guide snippets. Also add sample curl examples for admins.
Sam (platform): I'll wire telemetry sampling and the canary policy.
John (qa): I'll schedule the test matrix run and assign flaky watchers.
Anne (eng-platform): Deploy-bot, kick off the shim canary once the PR is merged.
deploy-bot: shim-canary-deploy triggered for internal-api-gateway staging. Canary at 5%. Logs: ok so far, no increased 5xx in the last 10m. :eyes:
Mira (devex): Quick note on messaging: call it "route header migration" in user docs (avoid internal names). Provide a single migration snippet per SDK to reduce support noise.
Anne (eng-platform): Perfect. I'll keep this thread as the checklist and update with links to PRs once created. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
